message: The other day, as the weather app buzzed ominously about a storm heading our way, I decided to make the best of it. I gathered up some blankets, brewed a pot of tea, and set up a little cozy corner in the living room for my grandkids. We turned what could have been a dreary day into a mini camping trip indoors, complete with stories and snacks. Sometimes, all it takes is a little creativity to make a storm feel like an adventure, doesn’t it? ☕
